name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
candidate:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intro h
  have happ {a b c d : List CoreIdent} (ha : a ⊆ c) (hb : b ⊆ d) :
      a ++ b ⊆ c ++ d := List.append_subset.mpr ⟨
        List.subset_append_of_subset_left d ha,
        List.subset_append_of_subset_right c hb⟩
  induction h with
  | const | op | bvar | fvar =>
    exact fun _ h => nomatch h
  | abs _ ih => exact ih
  | quant _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact happ ih₁ ih₂
  | ite _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ => exact happ (happ ih₁ ih₂) ih₃
  | eq _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact happ ih₁ ih₂
  | app hfn he hn ihfn ihe =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    . exact fun _ h => h
    . next hne =>
      exfalso
      specialize hn (by constructor)
      cases hn
      apply hne
      rfl
    . exact happ ihfn ihe
